title: Layout / safe-area construction

location.series: Elvis Dinh / Instagram brand design system / project year 2022

slide_intent: Make the usable composition area explicit so signatures and copy remain clear at the edge.
strategic_value: A repeatable frame can hold Instagram photography, message and attribution together across sizes.
demonstration: A Find your people execution gains a grid, reduces inside a white field, then resolves into an inset diagram labelled 1/12 short side.
practical_value: Derive the demonstrated inset from the short side rather than a fixed pixel value.

content_islands.name: Campaign composition
content_islands.spec: Start with the overhead photograph, central white message, upper-right glyph and lower signatures.

content_islands.name: Grid and inset diagram
content_islands.spec: Reveal alignment lines before isolating a pink border and short-side measurement.

reference_purposes.Application: The sequence traces a finished campaign back to its layout guides.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The inset diagram labels the margin as 1/12 of the short side.

ingredient.name: Layout inset
ingredient.role: Keep messages and signatures inside a consistent usable field.
ingredient.application: Use the shown inset of one twelfth of the short side.
ingredient.scope: The case-study construction example; no additional format exceptions are supplied.
